business_problem: build a near-real-time 360-degree customer view that links store, ecommerce, and loyalty data so teams can personalize retail experiences faster.
solution_summary: Rinascente uses Snowflake and Snowpark on Snowflake to build a near-real-time 360-degree customer view that links store, ecommerce, and loyalty data so teams can personalize retail experiences faster. Customer, product, transaction, and campaign data are centralized in Snowflake so marketing, merchandising, and customer-experience teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Snowpark keeps transformation and application logic close to the governed data instead of forcing the team to move workloads into separate compute environments. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Rinascente achieved ≅80% faster processing for Rinascente’s heaviest reports and 892 GB of customer data processed in Snowflake.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Runs transformations, analytics, and application logic directly where Snowflake data already lives.

data_flow: customer, product, transaction, and campaign data flow into Snowflake and Snowpark; curated data, reports, and model outputs are then served to marketing, merchandising, and customer-experience teams.
